latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Media.io AI Dance Video Generator skill.

- Integrates with Media.io OpenAPI to generate AI dance videos using image and video URLs.
- Supports asynchronous task creation and polling for dance video generation status.
- Includes credit checking before generation requests.
- Provides structured API invocation and error handling guidance.
- Requires MEDIAIO_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
